summary: Only a per-section cap exists: 4000 chars, and an over-cap section is skipped, not truncated; adjacent budgets are 3000 (pre_llm_call) and 1200 (advisor brief); four sections registered.
Measured costs: session-context 303/3402 (headroom 3697/598), persona 276-321 fixed, goal 0 to 3621 worst case (headroom 4000/379), advisories variable; no enforced total cap.

No repo-rules digest: AGENTS.md is 25085 chars so a 4000-char section carries 16 percent and is skipped silently when over; it would be a fifth unguarded governance copy; naming the file in the prompt costs one line and is always current.
AGENTS.md line 247 carries exactly one U+200D in the teacher sequence (0x1f9d1 0x200d 0x1f3eb); any replacement must avoid ZWJ sequences since the scanner blocks on the joiner.
Doc validators would not break: emoji enforcement is removed (EMOJI_REQUIRED_TYPES empty), SECTION_EMOJIS does not police H2s, and has_emoji stays true via the leading single-codepoint emoji.

Byte-drift checks do not key on the heading: sync-gate1-pointers extracts a single Gate 1 line into .codex/AGENTS.md and .cursor/rules/skill-routing.md; the pre-commit mirror list excludes AGENTS.md; CLAUDE.md is a symlink.
Only historical scratch snapshots under the sk-doc 055 packet carry the old heading; no automated comparison and no test asserts it.
Blast radius is one line and zero automated checks; pair the change with a Hermes-side pre/post scan proof since the only rejecting consumer is outside the repo.
